notes.title: DARK SWORD: PATCH 1.1.2: Newgame+
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added NewGame+ mode: after completing a run, you can now restart the game with increased difficulty. Keeping all the items and powers you got from the previus run!
[*] A new exclusive item can now be obtained at the end of a run.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Game settings now persist correctly, even without manually saving. Volume, language, and other preferences will be kept automatically.
[*] Minor stability improvements and small scene behavior fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for playing Dark Sword: The Light of Ainn. More updates and content are on the way!

notes.title: DARK SWORD PATCH 1.1.1 Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Cultists now die with the laser staff
[*] Fixed secret keys bug
[*] Cleanse spell no longer cast when changing the keybind
[*] Providence Icon glitch reset ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) 
[/list]


[b]Gameplay Adjustments & Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Acid floor does more damage
[*] Boss health increased in challenge mode 
[*] All bosses now receive an extra percentage of HP as you defeat other bosses, with the cap being 70% more health (in the future this will increase in challenge mode and NG+).
[/list]

notes.title: DARK SWORD PATCH 1.1.1 Spanish translation & bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Developer's command to add all powers removed.
[*] Player hitbox slightly adjusted
[*] Campfire in Providence combat now stays out of boss fight
[*] Hitting stones with the hammer no longer grants the same item many times
[*] Fixed bug where the camera in statue cinematic goes to infinity
[*] Walls fixed in Elderoth arena
[*] FX sounds that didn't go away with the audio at minimum now they do it
[*] Fixed bug where inventory item description is visible without opening the inventory.
[*] Fixed some sprite overlapping bugs
[/list]



[b]Gameplay Adjustments & Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Providence icon now can not be used inside the mausoleum of alserac
[*] Spanish translation (80%)
[*] High-resolution rendering can be activated through pause menu
[*] Activation of developer commands with CTRL + B
[*] Level can be restarted by pressing “C” with developer commands activated
[*] New small area in the prelude to the secret crystal
[/list]

notes.title: DARK SWORD PATCH 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed game saving bug when pausing the game.
[*] Achievements fixed (and one more added).
[*] Fixed wall bug in the Pits area.
[*] Fixed dashing through the stone hand bug.
[*] Fixed issue where the stone head would break incorrectly with the hammer.
[*] Enemies can no longer enter the Elderoth Zone after boss activation.
[*] Fixed Secarta bug when deactivating boss walls.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Adjustments & Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a counter in the inventory for Orbs and Ingots.
[*] Nerfed staff range.
[*] The Portal Stone, previously located on the Bridge of the Horned One, is now at another location
[*] Added hint text in the Blacksmith's Area.
[/list]
